title: Etale triple algebras map flatly to the strict henselization completion
statement: Let R be a Noetherian local commutative ring with maximal ideal m, let K be a separable closure of its residue field, and let C=R^{\mathrm{sh}} be the strict henselization defined as the filtered colimit of pointed etale R-algebras with residue embeddings into K [lem-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-triples]. For every triple (S,q,phi) in this filtered triple category, the canonical map S\to\widehat C=\varprojlim_n C/(mC)^n induced by S\to C is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map].

source.place: Lemma Tag 06LJ (lemma-henselization-noetherian), proof part (c), paragraph beginning 'To finish the proof of (c)'

proof.text: Fix a triple (S,q,phi) in the filtered category. The per-triple strict-henselization identification [lem-sc-etale-triple-strict-henselization-identification] identifies the colimit C with the strict henselization A^{\mathrm{sh}} of the local ring A=S_q, carrying the maximal ideal qA to mC. Hence it identifies the completion of A^{\mathrm{sh}} at qA^{\mathrm{sh}} with the displayed completion C-hat.

source.place: Lemma Tag 06LJ, proof part (c), paragraph beginning 'To finish the proof of (c)'; strict-henselization construction and the preceding henselization-triples identification

proof.text: The etale map Spec S \to Spec R is locally of finite presentation by the definition of etale morphisms [def-weil-etale-morphism], so the affine finite-presentation lemma [lem-weil-pbc-lfp-affine-opens-finite-presentation] makes S a finite-type R-algebra. Thus S is Noetherian because R is Noetherian [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra-noetherian]. Localizing at q preserves Noetherianity [lem-weil-pbc-localization-noetherian], hence A=S_q is a Noetherian local ring. The strict-henselization completion flatness-over-the-base statement [lem-sc-strict-henselization-completion-flat-over-base] applied to A says that A \to (A^{\mathrm{sh}})^\wedge is flat.

source.place: Lemma Tag 06LJ, proof part (c), paragraph beginning 'To finish the proof of (c)'

proof.text: The localization map S \to A=S_q is flat [lem-weil-pbc-localization-flat]. Composing it with the flat map A \to (A^{sh})-hat from the previous step is flat by [lem-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map-comp]. Under the completion identification of Step 1, this composite is exactly the canonical map S \to C-hat, so that map is flat.
